records.title: Delta Vacations - Skymiles and Medallion Members Save

sailingWindow.rawText: For sailings on or between 06/01/2026 and 11/30/2026

records.promotionDetailsRaw:
DELTA VACATIONS ON SALE - MEDALLION MEMBERS SAVE UP TO $250 DOLLARS OFF

This summer save when you book getaways to select destinations all in one place with Delta Vacations.  Your Cruise Brothers Travel Specialitst will help you plan your next vacation to the Caribbean, Mexico, Hawaii, South Pacific, Europe and more!

When you use a travel agent Medallion® Members save up to $250 per flight and hotel package using promo code SMMED26, and SkyMiles® Members save up to $200 per flight and hotel package using promo code SMSUMMER26.

Book by July 31, 2026

Travel between June 1 – November 30, 2026.

EXCEPTIONAL INFLIGHT EXPERIENCE

For an elevated cabin experience, book your client in Delta One®, Delta Premium Select or Delta Comfort.
	
 
EARN MILES & EARN MORE TOWARD MEDALLION STATUS

SkyMiles Members earn bonus miles on top of flight miles. Plus, they earn Medallion Qualification Dollars (MQDs) toward Status.
	
 
TRAVEL PROTECTION PREMIUM

Protect their travel investment and your commission with flexible change policies and Travel Protection Plans for cancellations, medical emergencies and more.
records.agentInstructionsRaw:
Medallion® Members Offer Terms and Conditions   

Purchase any Delta Vacations package that includes a flight and hotel, from any Delta Vacations origin in the U.S. to any Delta Vacations destination within the U.S. (including Alaska and Hawai’i), Canada, Mexico, the Caribbean or Central America, between June 1 – July 31, 2026, for travel between June 1 – November 30, 2026. 
At time of reservation, you must refer to promotional code SMMED26. 
Offer only valid if the Primary Passenger is a Medallion Member. 
Minimum 4-night stay required. 
For air-inclusive packages, offer is valid on reservations that include a minimum of one flight on Delta Air Lines®. Service may be operated by Delta Air Lines and one of our Flight Partners. Learn more: Partner Airlines | Delta Air Lines.  
Reservations that include only flights on other airlines do not qualify. 
No minimum purchase price required. Package must include flight and hotel, plus any optional car rentals, transfers, excursions and/or activities. 
Discount is $50 off bookings of up to $1,499; $100 off bookings of $1,500 – $3,999; $150 off bookings of $4,000 – $6,999 and $250 off bookings of $7,000 or more. 
Maximum discount is $250 per booking; discount is a percentage of each eligible land component. 
Additional baggage charges for checked luggage may apply, as well as any applicable hotel/resort fees or departure taxes collected by hotel/resort/airport at destination. 
Offer is not applicable to airfare; for groups of 10 or more people; and is not retroactive. 
Must be purchased through Delta Vacations.

records.title: Margaritaville at Sea - 50% Off, Kids Free - July 4th Flash Sale

sailingWindow.rawText: For sailings on or between 04/01/2026 and 05/31/2027

records.promotionDetailsRaw:
4th of July Flash Sale - Book June 22 - July 7th! Bring the Family!

50% off cruise fares
3rd & 4th Guests Sail Free
Up To 50% Off Drink Packages
Margaritaville at Sea Summer Savings Sale!
Kids Sail Free - Complimentary Stateroom Upgrades - Half Off Fares

From easy-breezy Bahamas getaways to adventurous Caribbean voyages, Margaritaville at Sea is the only cruise where world-class dining, famous boat drinks, vibrant entertainment, and ahhh-worthy spas come together with iconic Margaritaville experiences. Whether you’re planning a family-friendly escape or a quick weekend cruise for two, this offer makes “yes” the easiest decision you’ll make all year.Set sail with our award-winning crew and discover a journey as unforgettable as the stunning destinations.

Kids Sail Free on select dates
Let them live their adventure — without the extra cost.

Complimentary Stateroom Upgrade
Because your 5 o’Clock state-of-mind deserves a little extra room to stretch out.

50% off Cruise Fares on select dates.

Award-Winning Experiences
Cruise with confidence. Named #1 Best Ocean Cruise Line by Cruise Critic two years running, Margaritaville at Sea delivers laid-back luxury, nonstop fun, and memories that stick long after the tan fades.

Summer Cruises
You can sail to The Bahamas, Mexico, Key West, and beyond for about the same? More sunsets. More sea breeze. Way better story to tell.

Kids Sail Free now on Beachcomber: $0 fare for 3rd and 4th guests when they are between 3 and 12 years old at the time of departure, traveling in a stateroom with a minimum of two paying guests.

New 2027 Destinations on Paradise
Now sail from Palm Beach to Grand Turk and Bimini with new 2027 departures.

*offers are subject to select dates and availability

records.title: Viking Cruises - Spirit of Independence Sale - Dollars Off, Onboard Credit + more!

sailingWindow.rawText: For sailings on or between 10/01/2026 and 04/30/2029

records.promotionDetailsRaw:
VIKING CRUISES - Savings, Free Air, Free Beverage Package and more! 

To celebrate America’s 250th anniversary, we are reminded of the enduring spirit of independence and the power of travel to inspire. At Viking, we design experiences For The Thinking Person, with unforgettable journeys spanning all seven continents. In honor of America’s milestone anniversary, this month enjoy our offer Spirit of Independence Sale.

Spirit of Independence Sale

Save up to $4,000 per couple
FREE International Airfare*  | $250 Shipboard Credit per person
FREE Beverage Package  | $25 Deposit
Offer code: A250

***********************************************************************************

ABOUT VIKING CRUISES

Adults-Only Environment: Viking ships do not permit passengers under the age of 18.
Cultural Enrichment: Instead of casinos or Broadway-style shows, entertainment includes port lectures, live regional music, and destination-focused dining.
Inclusive Fares: Fares generally cover shore excursions in every port, complimentary Wi-Fi, beer and wine with lunch and dinner, and access to onboard wellness areas.
Design & Comfort: Ships feature elegant Scandinavian designs, extensive al fresco dining spaces (like the Aquavit Terrace), and spacious staterooms. 
 
Types of Cruises Offered
River Cruises: Sailing Europe’s waterways (e.g., Rhine, Danube, and Seine), the Nile, and the Mekong. They also sail the Mississippi River in the United States.
Ocean Cruises: Operating a fleet of identical, mid-sized ships (typically holding 930 guests) that sail the Mediterranean, Northern Europe, Alaska, and the Americas.
Expedition Cruises: Specialized, Polar-class vessels designed for exploring remote regions like Antarctica and the Great Lakes.

**********************************************************************************

Summer Sale - FREE INTERNATIONAL AIRFARE* - ALL INCLUSIVE VOYAGES FROM $2,399
$25 DEPOSIT - mention code: EBD

*******************************************************************************************

*FREE International Airfare valid for select 2026/2027/2028 departures. *FREE Airfare offer is subject to change. $25 deposit available on all 2026/2027/2028/2029 river voyages. Based on inventory availability at time of purchase and may be withdrawn at any time. Air does not have to be purchased to get cruise/cruisetour offer. All prices are in US dollars and for US residents only. Book and by deposit July 31, 2026; 2026: Pay in full by August 5, 2026, or at 120 days prior to departure; 2027: Pay in full by Sep 17, 2026; 2028: Pay in full by Mar 15, 2027; 2029: Pay in Full by Jan 13, 2028.

Promotions Booking Window: July 1 through July ‌31‌, 2026. New bookings only
